gloss: wound medicine; antiseptic ointment; salve for cuts and scrapes

definitions.gloss: wound medicine; antiseptic ointment; salve for cuts and scrapes
definitions.explanation: Topical medicine applied to cuts, scrapes, and minor wounds — usually an ointment, cream, or liquid disinfectant kept in the home first-aid kit.

examples.japanese: {傷薬|きずぐすり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}った→塗る：01174_nuru⟧。
⟦{転|ころ}んで→転ぶ：00863_korobu⟧ひざ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦すりむいた→すりむく：09100_surimuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{傷薬|きずぐすり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけた→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I fell and scraped my knee, so I put some antiseptic on it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{救急箱|きゅうきゅうばこ}→救急箱：19410_kyuukyuubako⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{傷薬|きずぐすり}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{包帯|ほうたい}→包帯：05385_houtai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{常備|じょうび}→常備：27113_joubi⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I keep wound medicine and bandages in the first-aid kit.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{傷|きず}→傷：02201_kizu⟧ (wound, scratch) + ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧ (medicine), with rendaku on the second element (くすり → ぐすり). A general everyday term covering disinfectants, ointments, and topical creams for minor injuries.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {傷薬|きずぐすり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}る→塗る：01174_nuru⟧: to apply wound medicine
- {傷薬|きずぐすり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to put on wound medicine
- {傷薬|きずぐすり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{効|き}く→効く：01932_kiku⟧: the medicine is effective

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {軟膏|なんこう}: ointment — more clinical term
- {消毒液|しょうどくえき}: disinfectant liquid — specifically for cleaning, not healing
- ⟦{絆創膏|ばんそうこう}→絆創膏：05386_bansoukou⟧: adhesive bandage, Band-Aid
